_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone Player {player_id} ci geemu LinesOfAction.
Yaa ay pièces '{side}', ay piècesu adversary '{other}'.
Formatu déplacement : `[b1b3]` (coord-from coord-to). Déplacement légal doomu ci kanamu horizontal, vertical, mbaa diagonal doomu ay carrés yépp, doomu ay pièces (yépp couleur) ci ligne. Mën nga tappi ci ay piècesu ngone, waaye mënul tappi ci ay piècesu adversary ; dalal doomu ci ay piècesu adversary, mën nga ko capture.  Nga gagné su ay piècesu ngone yépp 8-voisin connecté.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wàll bi war na nekk e2e4 (ci,si ay kooride).
invalid_move.identical: Li ko dale ak li mu jëm, benn la.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Jëf bi war na nekk bu jub walla ci wàllug diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: War na dem ba sore, mel ni ay téere yuy ànd.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Kàarta xulo bu ñuul bi ñakk àdduna.
invalid_move.destination_own: Destination bi moom na ay nitam.

game_action.captured_suffix: Jigéen {player_id} tuxu {from} -> {to} te di kojug énèr
